item.title: Faint stellar stream reveals dark matter clues
item.description: Astronomers identified the first globular cluster stellar stream outside the Milky Way, offering new insights into dark matter.

item.title: Early childhood screen time linked to later academic struggles
item.description: Higher screen time at ages 1 and 6 was associated with poorer academic outcomes and weaker working memory in later years.

item.title: Common medications may alter gut bacteria for years
item.description: A study of over 2,500 people suggests that common medications can have lasting effects on the gut microbiome, even after stopping use.

item.title: Bird flu spreads; backyard feeders may increase risk
item.description: As Australia's bird flu outbreak expands, backyard feeders could become hotspots for H5N1 by bringing species into close contact.
